properties.note: Current OSM administrative boundary (relation/1903516, admin_level 4). Hà Nội is still a centrally governed city; this is the full municipality, including outer districts such as Sơn Tây, not only the Old Quarter.

properties.osmName: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh cũ
properties.note: Historic OSM boundary relation/19267904 (Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh cũ), the pre-2025 city. The current admin relation/1973756 is the post-merger megacity and, as of this fetch, its outer ring also contains a broken spike down to about 8.3°N. The former city is the extent travellers mean by Sài Gòn / TP.HCM.

Historic OSM boundary relation/19297407 (Thành phố Đà Nẵng cũ). After the 2025 reform the live admin relation/1891418 also covers former Quảng Nam and would swallow Hội An, which is its own launch city. The former Đà Nẵng municipality keeps the two outlines separate.

Historic OSM boundary relation/7062047 (Thành phố Hội An). The 2025 communes leave only Phường Hội An (relation/19337535), which is essentially the ancient-town ward. The former city includes the old town, Cẩm An, and the Cửa Đại coast.

properties.osmName: Phường Phú Xuân + Thuận Hóa + Vỹ Dạ + An Cựu + Hương An
properties.note: Union of five current urban wards: Phú Xuân (19324115), Thuận Hóa (19324114), Vỹ Dạ (19324113), An Cựu (19324112), and Hương An (19324111). OSM has no single former-city relation for Huế. The live admin relation/1891483 is the whole former Thừa Thiên Huế province (now a centrally governed city), which is too large to read as the citadel city. Kim Long and Thủy Xuân wards were left out because their 2025 polygons run far into the southern hills.

Historic OSM boundary relation/7081538 (Thành phố Nha Trang). The current admin unit is only Phường Nha Trang (relation/16203649), a slice of the beachfront. The former city is the bay town travellers fly into.

Historic OSM boundary relation/19394120 (Thành phố Đà Lạt). Đà Lạt no longer has its own admin_level city relation after the 2025 commune mergers; the former municipality matches the pine-city extent.

OSM island polygon relation/12033833 (Đảo Phú Quốc). The historic city relation/7135978 reaches scattered southern islets around 9.2°N, and the current Đặc khu Phú Quốc (relation/12852607) is an admin shell. The main island coastline is the shape you see from the air.

Historic OSM boundary relation/7097141 (Thị xã Sa Pa). The current Phường Sa Pa (relation/19428217) is only the urban core. The former town-level boundary includes the town plus the nearby terraces without taking in all of Lào Cai.

properties.osmName: Tuần Châu, Việt Hưng, Bãi Cháy, Cao Xanh, Hồng Gai, Hạ Long, Hà Tu, Hà Lầm
properties.note: Union of the bayfront wards that replaced the former Hạ Long city: Tuần Châu (19272135), Việt Hưng (19272136), Bãi Cháy (19272137), Cao Xanh (19272138), Hồng Gai (19272140), Hạ Long (19272141), Hà Tu (19272144), and Hà Lầm (19272145). OSM no longer has one relation for the pre-2025 municipality. Inland Hoành Bồ and neighbouring Cẩm Phả are excluded so the glow stays on the city facing the bay.

Historic OSM boundary relation/7098009 (Thành phố Hà Giang), the former provincial capital. The old Hà Giang province (now part of Tuyên Quang) would cover the whole far-north loop and is the wrong shape for a city view. The town is where the map opens; the loop is a ride outward from here.
